:::{#rem-quadratic-form-bilinear}
#### A quadratic form is a bilinear form with equal vectors

<!-- check-results-in-remarks: allow -->
<!-- Reason for the allow: the display is the bilinear form definition with y = x, read off by substitution, not a result that needs a proof. -->

Setting $\vy = \vx$ in the [bilinear form](#def-bilinear-form) of $\matr{S}$
gives the [quadratic form](#def-quadratic-form) of $\matr{S}$:

$$
\bformf{\matr{S}}{\vx}{\vx} = \qform{\matr{S}}{\vx}.
$$

:::
